about: SOQL aggregates: COUNT, COUNT_DISTINCT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, GROUP BY (with ROLLUP and CUBE), GROUPING, HAVING and ordering by aggregates.

steps.query: SELECT COUNT() FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%'

cases.name: COUNT(field) counts non-null values; unaliased results are expr0, expr1…

steps.query: SELECT COUNT(Id), COUNT(Budget__c), COUNT_DISTINCT(Status__c) FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%'

cases.name: SUM, AVG, MIN and MAX, with aliases

steps.query: SELECT SUM(Budget__c) total, AVG(Budget__c) average, MIN(Budget__c) smallest, MAX(Budget__c) largest FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%'

cases.name: aliases and unaliased results mix, counting only the unaliased

steps.query: SELECT COUNT(Id) n, SUM(Budget__c), MAX(Headcount__c) FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%'
SELECT COUNT(Id) n, SUM(Budget__c) total, MAX(Budget__c) top FROM Project__c WHERE Name = '{tag} nothing'

cases.name: MIN and MAX of dates are dates

steps.query: SELECT MIN(Start_Date__c) earliest, MAX(Start_Date__c) latest FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%'
SELECT MIN(Name) lo, MAX(Name) hi FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%'
SELECT Status__c, COUNT(Id) n, SUM(Budget__c) total FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' GROUP BY Status__c ORDER BY Status__c
SELECT Status__c, Account__c, COUNT(Id) n FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' GROUP BY Status__c, Account__c ORDER BY Status__c, Account__c NULLS LAST

cases.name: GROUP BY without aggregates lists the distinct values

steps.query: SELECT Status__c FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' GROUP BY Status__c ORDER BY Status__c
SELECT Status__c FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' GROUP BY Status__c HAVING COUNT(Id) > 1
SELECT Status__c, SUM(Budget__c) s FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' GROUP BY Status__c HAVING SUM(Budget__c) >= 100 AND Status__c != 'Active'
SELECT Status__c, SUM(Headcount__c) h FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' GROUP BY Status__c ORDER BY SUM(Headcount__c) DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT Status__c, COUNT(Id) FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' GROUP BY Status__c ORDER BY COUNT(Id) DESC, Status__c LIMIT 2

cases.name: grouping by a parent field uses the field's name as the key

steps.query: SELECT Account__r.Name, SUM(Budget__c) FROM Project__c WHERE Account__c = '{acct}' GROUP BY Account__r.Name
SELECT CALENDAR_YEAR(Start_Date__c) y, COUNT(Id) n FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' GROUP BY CALENDAR_YEAR(Start_Date__c) ORDER BY CALENDAR_YEAR(Start_Date__c)

SELECT CALENDAR_MONTH(Start_Date__c) m, COUNT(Id) n FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND CALENDAR_YEAR(Start_Date__c) = 2024 GROUP BY CALENDAR_MONTH(Start_Date__c) ORDER BY CALENDAR_MONTH(Start_Date__c)
SELECT CALENDAR_QUARTER(Start_Date__c) q, COUNT(Id) n FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' GROUP BY CALENDAR_QUARTER(Start_Date__c) ORDER BY CALENDAR_QUARTER(Start_Date__c)
SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND CALENDAR_YEAR(Start_Date__c) = 2025
SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND DAY_IN_MONTH(Start_Date__c) = 30
SELECT Name FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' AND DAY_ONLY(Kickoff__c) = 2026-01-15

cases.name: a field that isn't grouped or aggregated is MALFORMED_QUERY

steps.query: SELECT Name, COUNT(Id) FROM Project__c

cases.name: aggregates of the wrong type are errors

steps.query: SELECT SUM(Name) FROM Project__c
SELECT Status__c, GROUPING(Status__c) grp, COUNT(Id) n FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' GROUP BY ROLLUP(Status__c)

cases.name: ROLLUP/subtotals for each level of two fields

steps.query: SELECT Status__c, Account__c, GROUPING(Status__c) gs, GROUPING(Account__c) ga, COUNT(Id) n, SUM(Budget__c) total FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' GROUP BY ROLLUP(Status__c, Account__c)
SELECT Status__c, Account__c, GROUPING(Status__c) gs, GROUPING(Account__c) ga, COUNT(Id) n FROM Project__c WHERE Name LIKE '{tag}%' GROUP BY CUBE(Status__c, Account__c)
SELECT GROUPING(Name), COUNT(Id) FROM Project__c GROUP BY ROLLUP(Status__c)

cases.name: errors/formula, roll-up, fractional number and datetime fields can't be grouped

steps.query: SELECT Is_Big__c, COUNT(Id) FROM Project__c GROUP BY Is_Big__c
SELECT Total_Hours__c, COUNT(Id) FROM Project__c GROUP BY Total_Hours__c
SELECT Budget__c, COUNT(Id) FROM Project__c GROUP BY Budget__c
SELECT Kickoff__c, COUNT(Id) FROM Project__c GROUP BY Kickoff__c
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM Project__c GROUP BY CALENDAR_YEAR(Kickoff__c)
